  "explanation": "The write-up derives all finiteness from the set-theoretic lemma, whose induction only characterizes transversals meeting C but is invoked on F_c for arbitrary X. The objection's instance checks out: for F={{1,2},{2,3},{2,4}}, C={1,2}, c=1 gives F_1={{2,3},{2,4}} with C'={2}, list {{2}}; the final list is {{2},{1,2}}, missing the transversal {1,3,4}. Moreover the lemma is false in general (ledger: F_k={x_1..x_k,y_k} is pairwise intersecting with infinitely many minimal finite transversals, e.g. {y_1..y_k,x_{k+1}}). No arithmetic large-prime-erasure argument appears anywhere else, so the finiteness step is unestablished and the approach, not a local edit, must change.",
